examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A short thread in a fixed-height log with the composer floating over its bottom (`composer` slot): the reader's questions at the inline end, the assistant's responses at the start, follow-up questions after the last one, and the thread scrolling under the composer.

examples.name: StartAlignment
examples.summary: The same thread in a narrow panel with every message at the inline start, as a drawer or side panel shows it.

examples.name: LongThread
examples.summary: Twelve turns that overflow the log: it opens at the newest message, stops following when the reader scrolls up, and the round Scroll to the latest message button above the floating composer brings them back.
